<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1205
Claimant:
Charles Velazquez
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
2-14-25
Calim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. The claimant is represented by
counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
3-15-25
Reviewed the policy file and confirmed the driver involved is a named driver on the policy. Coverage was in force at
the time of the loss, and nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.
4-22-25
Obtained the police report and statements from two witnesses. Both confirm the collision happened as described and
that the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. Scene photos and the other driver's account match the same
sequence of events.
5-28-25
Inspected the vehcile damage. The pattern and location are consistent with the described side impact, and no earlier
damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or repair records.
6-14-25
Counsel submitted the medical file reporting a knee injury. The injury is plausible for a collision of this type. The
claimant's account has been consistent across every conversation so far. Records also show a minor strain to the
same area years ago that healed fully.
6-29-25
Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as the claimant improved. Based on the records and the matching
vehicle damage, the injury appears related to this loss, and the file is moving to evaluation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
